==Description==
'''Commander Aquaman Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 6 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{BeachBalls|150}} or {{Robux|33}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|520}} or {{Robux|255}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|42}} with a total cost of {{Robux|324}}.

==Appearance==
'''Commander Aquaman Charm''' appearance is based on the {{Color|Surf|Aqua}} [[Commander]] skin. It has the skin floating in the air while holding its trident. When used, it plays its "''Attack my aquatic comrades!''" voiceline.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*The charm calls the {{Color|Surf|Aqua}} [[Commander]] the "''Aquaman''" skin instead of the "''Aqua''" skin.
**This is most likely because the skin was originally referred to as "''Aqua Man''".
